skills.name: Marriage
skills.text: Once during Sun Shangxiang's turn, she can discard two hand cards and select a male character who is not at full health. By doing so, she heals herself and the male character by one unit of health each.

skills.name: Armed Consorts
skills.text: For each piece of equipment that leaves her equipment area, Sun Shangxiang draws two cards.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
